subject: Your bulk hoodie request
body: We can supply 8 size M CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies from current stock, but we can’t fill all 20 from stock; 12 would need to be restocked. The list price is $58 each, and a proposed discounted price must remain conditional on approval. The restock cost for the 12-unit shortfall is $264, and $22 per hoodie is break-even—so any proposed price below $22 would be below cost. We’ll confirm whether we can offer a discount and complete the order after the pricing and restock arrangements are approved.
